subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own topic-name-to-topic_id resolution for routing: an observed topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver action, or injected session context?
rationale: The current cache provides observed id-to-name data, but reversing it for routing requires maintainer intent for duplicate names, stale data, closed topics, and never-observed topics.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can route only after resolving ambiguity.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id resolver that returns structured ambiguity or not-found results instead of silently choosing a stale or duplicate topic.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs Only
options.body: Document numeric topic ids as the only supported routing contract until Telegram topic catalogs have stronger product direction.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can route only after resolving ambiguity.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current topic-name cache and Telegram action surface history that would anchor the resolver contract.
